 MBB Preview: Arkansas vs Indiana @ Bad Boy Mower Series – New York 
 November 16, 2026 
 Who:   #20/23 Arkansas Razorbacks (3-1, 0-0 SEC) vs -/RV Indiana Hoosiers (4-0, 0-0 Big Ten)
 What: The Razorbacks will be playing in Madison Square Garden for the second time in three seasons and making their 13th appearance in “The World’s Most Famous Arena.”
 When:  Tuesday – Nov. 17 – 7:30 pm (ET) / 6:30 pm (CT)
 Where:  New York, N.Y. • Madison Square Garden (19,812)
 How (to follow): 
–  TV/Stream:  Peacock TV/ Watch Peacock/NBCSN  (Paul Burmeister, Robbie Hummel and Caroline Pineda)
 – Radio:   Learfield Razorback Sports Network  (Chuck Barrett and Matt Zimmerman)
–  Sirius/XM:  83 || SXM App/Online Channel 83 
 –  Arkansas Live Stats 
 –  Razorback Gameday App 
 –  Arkansas Game Notes     
 –  Indiana Game Notes 
– SEC Notes 
 FAYETTEVILLE – Two iconic programs will square off in an iconic venue when the Arkansas Razorbacks face the Indiana Hoosiers on Tuesday (Nov. 17) in Madison Square Garden for the Bad Boy Mowers Series – New York. Tipoff is set for 7:30 pm (ET) / 6:30 pm (CT), and the game will be broadcast on PeacockTV.
 Arkansas and Indiana have met on five previous occasions and the Razorbacks lead 3-2, including a 1-0 advantage at neutral-site games. Arkansas has won three of the last four in the series.
 The teams first met on Dec. 15, 1949, in Bloomington with the Hoosiers winning, 75-50. They did not meet again until Mar. 2, 2008, in Raleigh, N.C., for the first round of the NCAA Tournament. The Hogs won, 86-72.
 Then, in a two-year span, the teams played three times, twice in Fayetteville and once in Bloomington. The last two games in the series came down to the last second, each team winning on their home court.
 Arkansas returns home to host Mississippi Valley State on Friday (Nov. 20). Tipoff is set for 7 pm and the game will be broadcast on SEC Network+.
 NOTES :
 In addition to Arkansas owning a 3-2 advantage in the series versus Indiana, Razorback head coach is 3-2 versus the Hoosiers as well. All five of those meetings came while Coach Cal was at Kentucky.
 Arkansas is 4-8 when playing in Madison Square Garden, but are 2-3 in the current building that is The Garden (located at Penn Station on 8th between 31st and 33rd streets). Arkansas played seven times in the third iteration of MSG, which was located on 8th between 49th and 50th streets from 1925-68.
 Coach Cal is 16-12 when playing in The Garden, including a Razorback win over nationally ranked Michigan in the 2024 Jimmy V Classic. He has won 10 of his last 14 trips to The Garden. Highlights include winning the 2K Sports Hoops Challenge in 2027 and the 2007 Jimmy V Classic while at Memphis, while winning the 2011, 2016 and 2019 Champions Classic as Kentucky head coach.
 Billy Richmond III went 3-of-3 from 3-point range versus Central Arkansas. Including the two exhibitions, Richmond is 8-of-14 (.571).
 Arkansas had 25 assists with just 10 turnovers versus Robert Morris, then had 19 assists with 11 turnovers versus Central Arkansas. The Hogs have improved 138 spots the last two games in assist-turnover margin, going from 213th (1.12) after Virginia to 104th (1.5) after Robert Morris and to 75th (1.6) after UCA. The Hogs have improved 131 spots in assists per game over the last two games, going from 200th (14.5) after Virginia to 81st (18.0) after Robert Morris and to 69th (18.3) after UCA.
